title: Eupalinolide B alleviates ulcerative colitis by targeting HMGB1 through modulation of the HMGB1/TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Luo, Wennan; Zhuang, Yuan; Shen, Shengnan; Wang, Yaxu; Zhu, Yongping; Liu, Yanqing; Zhang, Shujie; Zhang, Junzhe; Li, Sainan; Zhong, Linying; Xia, Fei; Pan, Lu; Meng, Yuqing; Gao, Peng; Liu, Qingbo; Wang, Jigang; Gu, Liwei
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物EB通过共价结合HMGB1蛋白Cys106残基抑制炎症通路治疗溃疡性结肠炎，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白靶点，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic, relapsing inflammatory bowel disease with limited therapeutic options. Eupalinolide B (EB), a guaianolide sesquiterpene lactone derived from Eupatorium lindleyanum DC., exhibits anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory activities. This study investigated the therapeutic potential and mechanism of EB against UC. METHODS: In vitro anti-inflammatory effects of EB were assessed in LPS-induced RAW264.7 and IEC-6 cells by measuring NO production and inflammatory cytokine mRNA levels (IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha). In vivo, a DSS-induced UC mouse model was used to evaluate EB's efficacy through body weight, DAI score, immunohistochemistry, and inflammatory factor levels. Target identification employed activity-based protein profiling (ABPP) with an EB-based probe, followed by validation via pull-down, CETSA, SIP, and immunofluorescence assays. Binding affinity and site were characterized using isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), LC-MS/MS, molecular docking, and mutagenesis. Molecular mechanism was explored by analyzing HMGB1/TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway by WB, qPCR and co-precipitation. RESULTS: EB exerted anti UC effects by alleviating inflammation and enhancing intestinal barrier integrity in vitro and in vivo. Using ABPP, high mobility group box-1 protein (HMGB1) was established as a high-confidence target of EB, characterized by the covalent binding of Cys106 residue. Mechanistically, EB suppressed the TLR4/MyD88/NF kappaB pathway and disrupted HMGB1 TLR4 interaction. CONCLUSION: EB ameliorates UC and exerts anti-inflammatory effects by targeting HMGB1 at Cys106 residue. By downregulating HMGB1 protein expression and reducing the binding affinity between HMGB1 and TLR4, EB inhibits the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. This study provides theoretical support for the development of EB as a potential anti-UC candidate drug.
abstract_zh: 背景：溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）是一种慢性、复发性炎症性肠病，治疗选择有限。Eupalinolide B（EB）是一种源自林泽兰（Eupatorium lindleyanum DC.）的愈创木烷型倍半萜内酯，具有抗炎和免疫调节活性。本研究探讨了EB对抗UC的治疗潜力及其机制。方法：在LPS诱导的RAW264.7和IEC-6细胞中，通过测量NO产生和炎症细胞因子mRNA水平（IL-6、IL-1β、TNF-α）评估EB的体外抗炎效果。在体内，使用DSS诱导的UC小鼠模型，通过体重、DAI评分、免疫组织化学和炎症因子水平评估EB的疗效。靶点鉴定采用基于EB探针的活性蛋白谱分析（activity-based protein profiling, ABPP），并通过pull-down、CETSA、SIP和免疫荧光实验进行验证。结合亲和力和位点通过等温滴定量热法（isothermal titration calorimetry, ITC）、LC-MS/MS、分子对接和突变分析进行表征。分子机制通过WB、qPCR和共沉淀分析HMGB1/TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB通路进行探索。结果：EB通过减轻炎症和增强肠道屏障完整性在体外和体内发挥抗UC作用。利用ABPP，高迁移率族蛋白B1（high mobility group box-1 protein, HMGB1）被确定为EB的高置信度靶点，其特征是Cys106残基的共价结合。机制上，EB抑制TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB通路并破坏HMGB1-TLR4相互作用。结论：EB通过靶向HMGB1的Cys106残基改善UC并发挥抗炎作用。通过下调HMGB1蛋白表达并降低HMGB1与TLR4之间的结合亲和力，EB抑制TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB信号通路。本研究为EB作为潜在抗UC候选药物的开发提供了理论支持。
